evals.prompt: Use $ywc-parallel-executor --all --tasks-dir tasks/ --local-merge.
evals.expected_output: In pre-flight, checks the clean working tree, base branch, tasks/dependency-graph.md, and stale worktree audit. Builds waves from Depends On, Conflicts With, and Shared Surfaces in the dependency graph, then runs each same-wave task in a separate worktree and branch. Keeps wave boundaries as hard gates, and each task must complete delivery, Mark Complete, and worktree cleanup before the next wave starts. The Completion Report includes task status, merge SHA, worktree cleanup status, final audit, and Completion Status.

evals.prompt: Run two tasks with Conflicts With entries in tasks/dependency-graph.md in the same parallel wave.
evals.expected_output: Treats Conflicts With as a hard constraint, not a hint. Does not place the two tasks in the same wave; instead adjusts the wave boundary or reports a reconsider verdict. Does not run a conflict pair concurrently even if the user wants faster execution.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-parallel-executor 000001-010..000001-030 --per-task-pr.
evals.expected_output: Does not merely create each per-task PR and move on. Performs the full lifecycle: PR creation, CI wait, bot review polling, CI re-gate after bot fixes, gh pr merge --delete-branch, base sync, and completion marker commit/push. Preserves the worktree and branch for failed tasks and cleans up only successful tasks.

evals.prompt: A stale .ywc-run-state.json from $ywc-parallel-executor 000001-010..000001-030 exists with saved waves[].tasks, then the user runs $ywc-parallel-executor 000002-010..000002-030 --tasks-dir tasks/.
evals.expected_output: Pre-flight Resume Detection validates intent-match between the saved waves[].tasks set and the current explicit range. If the saved task set and requested range mismatch, it refuses silent resume and requires an explicit choice between resuming the saved run and discarding the stale run-state for a new run. The discard path must include cleanup guidance for the saved worktrees and branches, not only deleting .ywc-run-state.json, and no wave planning or task execution starts before that choice.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-parallel-executor 000003-010..000003-020 --local-merge where both same-wave tasks edit the public Invite API contract.
evals.expected_output: Treats the shared public Invite API contract as a Shared Surface, not merely a file overlap. It does not dispatch both tasks independently in the same wave unless a shared contract is defined before dispatch; otherwise it serializes them into separate waves or reports a reconsider verdict. Worker payloads include Changed Public Contracts, Critical Internals, Cross-Module Impact, and tdd-deep-module-gray-box guidance.

evals.prompt: A behavior-changing worker in $ywc-parallel-executor returns DONE but lists no authored/touched tests and no TDD exception.
evals.expected_output: Does not merge the task as clean DONE. It requires task-local contract or behavior test evidence, re-dispatches the worker, marks the task DONE_WITH_CONCERNS with an explicit TDD exception, or blocks the task. The final report includes tests authored/executed, Changed Public Contracts, Critical Internals, and TDD Exceptions per task.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-parallel-executor 000005-010..000005-040 --aggregate-pr --group-name reporting --pr-lang zh.
evals.expected_output: Treats `--pr-lang zh` as a supported aggregate PR language. The final aggregate PR path preserves the exact value and passes `$ywc-create-pr --lang zh`; it does not convert Chinese to English/Japanese/Korean or drop the flag during wave accumulation.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-parallel-executor 000006-010..000006-020 --draft --pr-lang es.
evals.expected_output: Treats `--pr-lang es` as a supported draft PR language. The draft aggregate PR path preserves the exact value and passes `$ywc-create-pr --lang es`; it does not infer a different language or omit the language flag when creating the draft PR.

evals.prompt: Use $ywc-parallel-executor 000007-010..000007-020 --per-task-pr --pr-lang zh.
evals.expected_output: Treats `--pr-lang zh` as a supported per-task PR language. Each per-task PR creation path preserves the exact value and delegates from the task worktree to `$ywc-create-pr --lang zh`; it does not fall back to raw `gh pr create` with untranslated placeholder title/body text.

evals.name: parallel-quality-gate-no-contract
evals.prompt: A parallel task has contract_state `N/A — no quality gate contract`, and another task uses report-only.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the existing verification, rerouting, worktree, and wave-delivery lifecycle. Emits no placeholder packet and dispatches neither Cleaner nor Hardener; report-only records only sanitized evidence or a gap.

evals.name: parallel-cleaner-before-delivery
evals.prompt: A completed parallel task has a valid advisory or enforced packet whose measured complexity exceeds its approved threshold.
evals.expected_output: After Task Verify and before Wave Delivery, dispatches exactly one task-local Cleaner with the unchanged bounded packet. Cleaner can edit only owned production paths and symbols and has no delivery authority.

evals.name: parallel-hardener-wave-boundary
evals.prompt: Two tasks in one wave produce sanitized mutation evidence after their Cleaner decisions.
evals.expected_output: Waits until the safe wave boundary, then dispatches Hardener only for tasks with remaining mutation work and a permitted Cleaner result or a legitimate threshold skip. Hardener is test/fixture-only and capped at three attempts.

evals.name: parallel-cleaner-blocks-hardener
evals.prompt: A task's Cleaner returns BLOCKED or NEEDS_CONTEXT while mutation survivors remain.
evals.expected_output: Does not dispatch Hardener for that task, preserves its worktree and branch, and applies existing rerouting and triage behavior.

evals.name: parallel-unavailable-tool-status
evals.prompt: An authorized quality-gate tool is unavailable for report-only, advisory, and enforced parallel contracts.
evals.expected_output: Report-only records a sanitized gap without mutation; advisory returns DONE_WITH_CONCERNS; enforced returns BLOCKED. No raw command, output, transcript, secret, or full diff crosses the boundary.

evals.name: parallel-residual-survivor-cap
evals.prompt: Hardener reaches the canonical three-attempt cap with mutation survivors.
evals.expected_output: Retains every sanitized survivor and evidence reference. Advisory aggregates DONE_WITH_CONCERNS and enforced aggregates BLOCKED; no worker labels a survivor equivalent or claims success merely because an attempt completed.

evals.name: parallel-status-precedence
evals.prompt: One task has DONE_WITH_CONCERNS or BLOCKED quality-gate evidence and a later task returns DONE.
evals.expected_output: Wave aggregation is monotonic: BLOCKED > NEEDS_CONTEXT > DONE_WITH_CONCERNS > DONE. The later DONE cannot erase the earlier status or sanitized concerns.

evals.name: parallel-ownership-and-evidence-rejection
evals.prompt: A packet crosses production/test Ownership, lacks changed symbols, has an invalid evidence path, or has a missing/mismatched command digest.
evals.expected_output: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT before any worker edit or dispatch; it never broadens paths/symbols or invents authorization.

evals.name: parallel-retry-idempotency-preservation
evals.prompt: A parallel Cleaner or Hardener dispatch encounters a recoverable tool error twice.
evals.expected_output: Changes bounded context or model class for recovery, never silently repeats the same dispatch identity, then stops after two failed recovery attempts as BLOCKED while preserving the task worktree and branch.

evals.name: parallel-no-delivery-authority
evals.prompt: A quality-gate worker or wave aggregate reports a clean result.
evals.expected_output: The result contains sanitized evidence and status only. It does not stage, commit, push, create or merge a PR, deliver changes, or authorize work outside task Ownership.

evals.name: parallel-out-of-ownership-path-symbol-rejection
evals.prompt: A Cleaner requests a production path or symbol outside the task packet's exact production Ownership, or a Hardener requests a test/fixture path or symbol outside its exact Ownership.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the request as NEEDS_CONTEXT before any worker dispatch or edit, does not broaden paths or symbols, and preserves the task worktree and branch under the existing failure handling.

evals.prompt: Non-interactive parallel resume has a checkpoint whose scope differs and no --resume-disposition.
evals.expected_output: Returns bounded NEEDS_CONTEXT naming --resume-disposition, invokes no executor, emits no prompt, and leaves checkpoint state unchanged.

evals.prompt: Parallel workers transition through branch conflict, CI timeout, and handoff failure.
evals.expected_output: Branch/worktree conflict is BLOCKED and CI timeout is DONE_WITH_CONCERNS; no branch waits for user input. The sole root aggregate handoff is atomically replaced, and a failed write preserves the previous valid cache.

evals.prompt: A parallel aggregate handoff is missing, malformed, stale, mismatched, private, or present in a worker worktree.
evals.expected_output: The reader rejects or ignores the cache, never accepts worker-local authority or peer conclusions, and reconstructs from checkpoint followed by current README.md and task.md without changing run state.

evals.prompt: Run the focused parallel transition safety fixtures.
evals.expected_output: python3 codex/skills/ywc-parallel-executor/scripts/test-transition-safety.py passes aggregate-location, worker-isolation, prompt-closure, identity, privacy, and atomic-preservation assertions.

evals.name: parallel-context-closure-matrix
evals.prompt: Run focused parallel fixtures for checkpoint resume, branch/worktree conflict, CI timeout, aggregate handoff failure, worker-local handoff, stale or mismatched identity, and privacy violations.

accepted: one valid aggregate handoff at root

evals.expected_status: DONE or DONE_WITH_CONCERNS for bounded closure; NEEDS_CONTEXT/BLOCKED for invalid inputs
evals.expected_handoff: accepts only one root aggregate; otherwise reconstructs from checkpoint then task source and preserves prior cache on write failure
evals.expected_output: No worker-local authority, peer conclusion, prompt, raw output, or authoritative state mutation is accepted.

evals.name: mixed-task-id-wave-compatibility
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-parallel-executor yk-000001-010..000001-030 --local-merge for a dependency graph containing yk-000001-010-root, 000001-020-legacy-task, and 001030-old-task.
evals.expected_output: Parses prefixed, current unprefixed, and legacy task IDs into the same phase/sequence wave model. It preserves dependency ordering, separate worktrees, delivery, completion moves, and cleanup semantics without renaming existing task directories.

evals.name: async-worker-silent-stall
evals.prompt: A successfully spawned parallel worker returns canonical task_name worker-010 but produces no attributable terminal payload for 600 seconds.
evals.expected_output: Records source task -> returned canonical target, monitors the returned target, sends at most one status request and one conditional interrupt at the next <=60-second heartbeat, then reconciles once more. It preserves failure only after proven quiescence; if possibly live, it blocks cleanup, next-wave dispatch, reports, and DONE.

evals.name: async-worker-terminal-during-escalation
evals.prompt: A parallel worker emits an attributable terminal payload during the 600-second escalation sequence.
evals.expected_output: Processes the delivered terminal payload before roster state, does not preserve failure, and performs no duplicate request or interrupt for the immutable dispatch identity.

evals.name: async-worker-failed-identity
evals.prompt: A parallel worker spawn succeeds without a usable returned canonical task_name, or returns an unparseable target.
evals.expected_output: Does not invent identity from the agent ID or requested label and does not add the worker to the active roster. It uses existing failed-dispatch handling and remains non-terminal if the response may represent a live worker.
